steps.html:
1. 01 · Fund

    A brand funds a category, never a verdict.Winix and Levoit each deposit into the purifier programme. Creators choose the rivals and write the verdict. Each brand pays only for its own lifted units, so an honest “buy the rival” verdict still earns.

  2. 02 · Randomise

    The catalogue randomises what agents see.The agent catalogue (a mock of PayPal's Store Sync in this demo) shows each shopping session the creator's test, a placebo from the same creator, or nothing. For a test's first 7 days half the sessions see it; after that, 5% are held out for good. Only the test is added or withheld. Ranking never changes.

  3. 03 · Passport

    The passport goes into the PayPal order.The catalogue signs an Agent Affiliate Passport recording what this session was shown. The agent checks out through PayPal with the buyer's saved wallet and the seller as payee, and puts the passport in Orders v2 purchase_units[].custom_id, so the capture joins the sale to its group even when another seller gets paid. In the demo, all 57 exposed Winix buys settled at Lumen, $4 cheaper, not Northwind, whose offer carried the test.

  4. 04 · Pay

    The engine pays only what the test caused.Credit is the attributable fraction at its 80% lower bound, at 8% commission, split by Shapley value when more than one creator's test was shown. Credits wait 30 days; refunds void them, and a dispute holds them until PayPal decides. Then one batch Payout pays the creators and the unspent deposit is refunded.
